chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Duets with Miguelito Valdes and "Tierra va a temblar"
summary: Machito explains the key change for Miguelito's singing and how Miguelito learned the arrangement in a day.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now, did Miguelito had his own orchestra or was he....
....with the Machito orchestra, because "Tierra Va Tembla", on the bottom of the 78 that I have it says Machito's orchestra and —
That was my own arrangement, but the thing is that we put a one-key up, you know, one higher up ....

.....because he was singing higher than me, so the first time that he sang with us at La Conga, that was a present because he didn't know about "Tierra Va Tembla"; He never heard of it, but you know he was so talented, he could learn a number so fast that we rehearsed for one day and he put in the show, "Tierra Va Tembla", in a special arrangement that I have for myself and I will give it to him.
Oh, so that was meant for you, not for him.
No - yes, it was for me.
Did you ever record that, "Tierra Va Tembla"?
I don't remember, I guess so.
